domain: Multi-platform SaaS billing and subscription management. A growth-stage analytics company (Verida Analytics) that simultaneously uses 8 billing platforms across different customer segments and geographies. Core business: B2B analytics SaaS with starter, pro, and enterprise tiers.

personas.name: growth-saas
personas.description:
Verida Analytics is a UK-based growth-stage B2B SaaS company operating across 8 billing platforms and a central Postgres users database. The dataset is a snapshot of the business as of 2026-05-15 and should reflect the following fixed commercial, operational, and cross-surface facts.

COMPANY SNAPSHOT:
  • Snapshot date: 2026-05-15 (Friday).
  • Billing history window: 2025-11-15 through 2026-05-15 inclusive.
  • Currency: GBP only. No USD, EUR, or AUD appears anywhere.
  • Every monetary field on every API surface is stored in pence. Use integers where that adapter normally uses integers and integer-strings where that adapter normally uses strings.
  • Billing platforms in scope: Stripe, Paddle, RevenueCat, Chargebee, GoCardless, Lemon Squeezy, Zuora, Recurly. Exactly these 8 platforms are present.

HEADLINE METRICS:
  • Total MRR across all 8 billing platforms: £138,900.
  • Total paying customers across all 8 billing platforms: 2,913.
  • Month-over-month growth: 8.2%.
  • MRR arithmetic check: £77,200 + £28,100 + £15,000 + £6,100 + £2,400 + £4,200 + £3,800 + £2,100 = £138,900.
  • Customer-count arithmetic check: 1,200 + 412 + 618 + 28 + 71 + 534 + 3 + 47 = 2,913.

STRIPE (web subscriptions):
  • Exactly 1,200 customers.
  • Exactly 856 starter customers. Every starter price row has unit_amount=2900 pence.
  • Exactly 284 pro customers. Every pro price row has unit_amount=7900 pence.
  • Exactly 60 enterprise customers. Every enterprise price row has unit_amount=49900 pence.
  • Stripe MRR is exactly £77,200. Arithmetic check: 856*29 + 284*79 + 60*499 = 24,824 + 22,436 + 29,940 = 77,200.

PADDLE (EU and international self-serve):
  • Exactly 412 customers.
  • Paddle MRR is exactly £28,100.
  • Every Paddle price row is GBP only.
  • Every Paddle price row has unit_price.amount stored as an integer-string of pence, for example "7900".
  • Every Paddle price row has unit_price.currency_code="GBP".
  • German localisation is driving +31% month-over-month growth in the EU segment.

REVENUECAT (mobile iOS and Android):
  • Exactly 618 active subscribers.
  • RevenueCat MRR is exactly £15,000.
  • Exactly 22 subscribers are in in_billing_retry state because of an Apple App Store outage on 2026-05-12 (Tuesday).
  • Week-over-week mobile revenue is down 23%.

CHARGEBEE (enterprise invoicing):
  • Exactly 28 customers.
  • Chargebee MRR is exactly £6,100.
  • Exactly 3 invoices are overdue with status="payment_due".
  • The overdue invoice totals are exactly £4,800, £4,200, and £3,400. Sum check: £12,400 total overdue.
  • The oldest overdue invoice has date=2026-04-11. That is exactly 34 days before 2026-05-15.
  • For every overdue invoice, due_date is strictly after date.

GOCARDLESS (UK SMB direct debit):
  • Exactly 71 customers.
  • GoCardless MRR is exactly £2,400.
  • There is exactly one direct-debit collection batch created on 2026-05-11 (Monday).
  • The payments attached to that batch sum to 840000 pence (£8,400).
  • Every payment in that batch has status="submitted" and charge_date=2026-05-13.
  • No other GoCardless batch exists with created date 2026-05-11.

LEMON SQUEEZY (indie and developer licenses):
  • Exactly 534 license holders.
  • Lemon Squeezy MRR is exactly £4,200.

ZUORA (large enterprise usage-based billing):
  • Exactly 3 active contracts.
  • Every Zuora contract is usage-based.
  • Zuora MRR is exactly £3,800.

RECURLY (legacy migrated subscribers):
  • Exactly 47 long-term subscribers.
  • Recurly MRR is exactly £2,100.

PRODUCT DATABASE (Postgres `users` table):
  • Exactly 3,794 rows total.
  • Every row has status="active" in lowercase.
  • No row has plan="".
  • Exactly 2,913 linked paid users have plan in {starter, pro, enterprise}. Each linked paid user has exactly one non-NULL billing linkage field among stripe_customer_id, paddle_customer_id, chargebee_customer_id, gocardless_customer_id, revenuecat_app_user_id, lemonsqueezy_customer_id, zuora_account_id, and recurly_account_code. That single non-NULL linkage resolves to a real row on the matching billing platform.
  • Exactly 847 free-tier users have plan="free". For every free-tier user, all 8 billing linkage fields are NULL. Approximately 50 free-tier users have a recent rate_limit_exceeded event.
  • Exactly 34 paid-plan orphans have plan in {starter, pro, enterprise}. For every orphan, all 8 billing linkage fields are NULL. Tag every orphan as data-integrity-orphan.
  • Exactly 14 pro-plan users have last_login_at < 2026-04-15. Tag those 14 as churn-risk.
  • Every other pro-plan user has last_login_at >= 2026-05-01.
  • User-table arithmetic check: 2,913 linked paid + 847 free-tier + 34 paid-plan orphans = 3,794 total users.
